title: Same ISF text for DynISF and AutoISF
body:
Below is the wrong message for the ISF tab of AutoISF of the profile tab. This message is indeed for DynISF because AutoISF is based on the ISF of the profile.

The text says that the profile ISF is used only if there is not enough data.

I don't know if there are 2 different texts for this location...
